name: Tin Mountain Conservation Center Summer Camp
description_short: Weekly nature day camps run by Tin Mountain Conservation Center at its Nature Learning Center in Albany, NH, where kids explore woods, ponds and fields. Older kids join Explorer camps that leave from Albany to hike, canoe, climb and camp out overnight. Tin Mountain also runs camps in Jackson, Tamworth and Fryeburg, ME.
refund_policy_summary: A $75 non-refundable deposit is due at registration. Full payment is due 4 weeks before camp starts. Cancellations or changes must be made at least 4 weeks before the session. No refunds after that.

sources.note: 2026 Summer Camp brochure. Prices are non-member rates. Only sessions held at or leaving from Albany are listed; Jackson, Tamworth and Fryeburg (ME) sessions are left out.
